snippet.title: Stack Order - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

Coming to Steam 2027: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4338750/Stack_Order/
